description: Default capability for the main window. sql:allow-execute is required by src/lib/db.ts (parameterized INSERT/UPDATE writes); the sql plugin ACL has no per-database or per-statement scoping, so the grant stays unscoped and the webview CSP (tauri.conf.json) is the compensating control. The shell and notification plugins are intentionally NOT granted: the system-audio sidecar is spawned Rust-side (audio_bridge.rs via std::process::Command) and meeting-start notifications are deferred to v2.
